::: {#def-constructive-proof}
#### Constructive proof

A **constructive proof** of a proposition $\exists x \in S,\ P(x)$ (@def-existential-quantifier)
names a particular element of $S$
and shows that $P$ is true of it
[@wikipedia_constructive_proof].
A proposition with several existential quantifiers,
such as "there are integers $m$ and $n$ with $m + n = 1$",
gets a constructive proof that names one element for each quantifier.

:::
